description: Regional outlook families (prompt 126, Intelligence-Design §9.2). Each family forecasts weekly event counts per region from reference_history: referenceFamily names the 121 reference family (conflict: ACLED where available, UCDP otherwise, then Foresignal's folded canonical events; seismic: USGS, then Foresignal; families with canonical events count Foresignal's folded canonical events, never raw records). observabilityFamily is the 116 family used for the LOW_DETECTABILITY flag; category is the ledger category of the window questions. Operators may edit this file; ids are lower case with ':' and '.' allowed.

families.label: Internet outages
families.sources: Foresignal canonical outage events (IODA and Cloudflare Radar)

families.label: Severe weather warnings
families.sources: Foresignal canonical weather-alert events (NWS and CAP warnings)

families.label: Earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 or more
families.sources: USGS ComCat, then Foresignal canonical seismic events
